name: @underway/editor
description: No entry point: consumed file by file through the @/editor/* path alias, as editor-ui is. The shared web editor's engine-bound pieces — the long-press radial menu, the tool sheet and popover, grid snap, the resize and rotate maths, the keyboard shortcuts, the toolbar's metadata and mode tables with the host-tool registry an app puts its own tools on, the shape glyphs, the mode capsule and the floating actions pill, and the session: the pure reducer and its entry builders, the camera maths, the canvas tap rules, the gestures, the brushes and the commit pipeline, with the session host an app plugs its parallel document and its own kinds of thing into — for Sol, DrawBot and CozyJournal. Unlike @underway/editor-ui it imports the engine freely; what it never imports is an app.
